correctness.rationale: The repeated-root formula \(G_j=j2^{1-j}\) is stated in arXiv:2609.33564v1. Substitution into the published trace-one summand gives an exact positive-weight adjacent-ratio formula. For all even \(N\ge10\), the \(j=4\)-to-\(6\) ratio is bounded above by \(11\pi^6/12150<1\), every later adjacent ratio by \(4\pi^4/567<1\), while the \(j=2\)-to-\(4\) ratio is greater than \(2\pi^2/9>1\). Exact ratios settle \(N=4,6,8\). The standalone rational checker independently reconstructs Bernoulli values through the tested range; finite checks are treated only as corroboration.
